listings.name: Blue Marlin
listings.desc: A modern 48ft flybridge yacht with a huge sun deck and a swim platform that drops straight into the sandbar. Captain Carlos has run Biscayne Bay for twelve years and knows every quiet anchorage between Key Biscayne and Stiltsville.

listings.name: Salt & Sun
listings.desc: The easy option for a group day on the water. Tritoon hull, quiet 150hp outboard, and a bimini that actually shades the whole deck. Boater education card required for Florida residents born after 1988.

listings.name: Vitamin Sea
listings.desc: Overnight-ready sailing catamaran. Sleep eight across four cabins, cook on board, and wake up anchored off Elliott Key. Marco skippers, Lia handles provisioning if you want it.

listings.name: Reel Deal
listings.desc: Center console with twin 300s. Half-day and full-day offshore trips for mahi, sailfish and wahoo. Tony cleans and bags your catch at the dock.

listings.name: Pacific Drift
listings.desc: Beneteau Oceanis 40 kept in charter condition. Sail to Paradise Cove or across to Catalina. ASA 104 or equivalent for bareboat; otherwise add Hannah as captain.

listings.name: Golden Hour
listings.desc: Sunset cruises along Venice and Santa Monica are the specialty. Crew of two, hors d'oeuvres available on request, and a flybridge that seats the whole party.

listings.name: Kelp Runner
listings.desc: Fast, dry and forgiving. Ideal for a run down to Palos Verdes to watch the dolphins. California boater card required.

listings.name: Fog Cutter
listings.desc: A stiff, well-balanced J/109 that loves the Bay's afternoon breeze. Loop past Alcatraz and under the Golden Gate. Bring layers.

listings.name: Bay Lady
listings.desc: Stable, warm and spacious. The Sausalito departure means calm water first, then the bridge in the afternoon. Great for groups who want a meal on board.

listings.name: Alcatraz Express
listings.desc: Ninety minutes of Bay highlights at speed. Luis narrates, you take the photos. Dress warm, it is San Francisco.

listings.name: Takamaka
listings.desc: Lagoon 50 with skipper and hostess. Island-hop Mahé to Praslin, La Digue and the Sainte Anne marine park. Multi-day itineraries are the norm here; provisioning arranged on request.

listings.name: Coco de Mer
listings.desc: Classic monohull sailing between the inner islands. Marie-Ange grew up on Praslin and anchors where the tour boats never go.

listings.name: Reef Hopper
listings.desc: Day boat for the north coast reefs and Silhouette Island. Skipper licence required for bareboat; a local skipper can be added at the dock.

listings.name: Praslin Star
listings.desc: Departs Praslin for Curieuse, Cousin and the sandbars off La Digue. Turtles almost guaranteed at Curieuse.

listings.name: Desert Pearl
listings.desc: Three decks, a jacuzzi on the sundeck and a full crew. Cruise past the Palm, Burj Al Arab and the Bluewaters wheel. Catering packages available.

listings.name: Marina Breeze
listings.desc: The standard Dubai Marina charter done properly: clean, on time, and a captain who knows where the swim spots are on a Friday.

listings.name: Palm Jet
listings.desc: Ninety-minute skyline loop or a two-hour run to the World Islands. Sunset slots go first.

listings.name: Northern Light
listings.desc: Hanse 385 based at Ocean Village. Day Skipper for bareboat, or George joins for a Cowes and Osborne Bay day. Solent tides explained on departure.

listings.name: Cowes Clipper
listings.desc: Watch the Cowes Week racing from the water, or run west to the Needles. Tea provided, obviously.

listings.name: Solent Rib
listings.desc: Blast to the Needles and Alum Bay. Jack races these things; he will go as fast or as gentle as the group wants.

listings.name: Sakura Maru
listings.desc: Tokyo Bay night cruise under Rainbow Bridge with the city lit up. Catering from a partner izakaya can be arranged.

listings.name: Umi no Kaze
listings.desc: Relaxed sailing out of Yokohama toward Miura. Japanese boat licence required for bareboat; Aiko skippers otherwise.

listings.name: Rainbow Bridge Cruiser
listings.desc: Hanami cruises in spring, fireworks in summer, and a very calm ride the rest of the year. Bring your own food and drinks.

listings.name: Formentera Dream
listings.desc: Ibiza to Formentera and the Ses Illetes sandbanks. Sofia's crew handles anchoring and lunch; you handle the swimming.

listings.name: Sunset Rider
listings.desc: Sunset at Café del Mar from the water, then back for dinner. Also runs Es Vedrà loops in the morning.

listings.name: Es Vedrà
listings.desc: Private-chef lunches, a Sea Bob for the brave, and anchoring off Cala Comte for the golden hour.

listings.name: Bella Positano
listings.desc: Amalfi, Positano, the Li Galli islands and a swim in the Grotta dello Smeraldo. Giuseppe's family has run this coast for three generations.

listings.name: Gozzo Sorrentino
listings.desc: The traditional wooden gozzo, refitted with a quiet diesel. Slow, close to the cliffs, exactly the way the coast should be seen.

listings.name: Capri Blu
listings.desc: Sail around Capri's Faraglioni and on to Nerano for lunch. Overnights to Ischia and Procida on request.

listings.name: Dalmatian Dream
listings.desc: Week-long island charters: Hvar, Vis, Brač and the Pakleni islands. ICC licence for bareboat, or Ivan skippers and books the restaurant moorings.

listings.name: Hvar Hopper
listings.desc: Blue Cave, Hvar town and the Pakleni beaches in one day. Croatian boat licence or ICC required.

listings.name: Adriatic Queen
listings.desc: Comfortable day or overnight charters with a Split-born captain. Ask for the Šolta lunch stop.

listings.name: Andaman Sky
listings.desc: Phang Nga Bay limestone karsts, James Bond island and a swim at Koh Yao Noi. Thai chef on board.

listings.name: Phi Phi Flyer
listings.desc: Private Phi Phi and Maya Bay trip leaving before the tour boats. Somchai times it so you get Maya Bay quiet.

listings.name: Longtail Luxe
listings.desc: A modern take on the longtail: quieter engine, real shade, proper seats. Coral Island and Racha Yai are the usual run.

listings.name: Harbour Hawk
listings.desc: Opera House, the bridge, then anchor in Store Beach for a swim. New Year's Eve books out a year ahead.

listings.name: Bondi Breeze
listings.desc: Harbour sailing with a Wednesday twilight racing option. NSW boat licence for bareboat.

listings.name: Manly Pontoon
listings.desc: Self-drive party pontoon for Middle Harbour. Fuel included for up to four hours.

reviewPool.name: Emma R.
reviewPool.text: Boat was spotless and exactly as described. The captain knew all the quiet coves.

reviewPool.name: Daniel K.
reviewPool.text: Smooth check-in at the marina and a great sound system. Would book again.

reviewPool.name: Priya S.
reviewPool.text: Slight delay at pickup, but the host made up for it with extra time on the water.

reviewPool.name: Lucas B.
reviewPool.text: Perfect for our group of eight. The snorkel gear was a nice touch.

reviewPool.name: Mei L.
reviewPool.text: Sunset cruise was unforgettable and the host answered messages within minutes.

reviewPool.name: Ahmed F.
reviewPool.text: Well maintained, plenty of shade, easy parking at the marina.

reviewPool.name: Sofia G.
reviewPool.text: Bareboat handover was clear and unhurried. Everything worked.

reviewPool.name: Noah W.
reviewPool.text: Fuel policy explained upfront, no surprises on the bill.

reviewPool.name: Isabella C.
reviewPool.text: Kids loved the swim platform. The host brought extra towels without being asked.

reviewPool.name: Ravi M.
reviewPool.text: Great value for the size. Take the captain option if you are unsure.

reviewPool.name: Chloe T.
reviewPool.text: Clean cabins and a very calm captain. We anchored in a gorgeous bay for lunch.

reviewPool.name: Jonas H.
reviewPool.text: Engine was a little loud at speed, otherwise a fantastic day out.
